text:
Ana (DevRel): pitch: 'Developer Accelerator: Snack & Ship' 16d 2 short tutorials, 1 tiny reference app, one compact benchmark note, 30-min live workshop. goal: fast wins for new devs + measurable trial lift. who wants what?
Ben (Growth): sounds good. KPIs: webinar RSVP -> attend rate, repo forks, trial starts from post-workshop email. need target numbers for the dashboard.
Priya (Content): I can write the launch post + two tutorial posts (step gifs). suggest microcopy variants for A/B on social.
Liam (PMM): bench story: focus on end-to-end developer cost (tokens + infra). hero stat: show quantized model with caching yields ~30% lower cost and similar latency. include a short reproducible command.
Sam (Design): I'll make a clean hero image and 3 step GIF templates. deliverables due 48h before the workshop.
ops-bot: uploaded assets: drive.redwood.ai/accel-snack/ (starter-repo, slide-deck, asset-pack)
Ana (DevRel): register funnel: blog -> tutorial -> register workshop -> post-workshop bench email. routing: add tag "accel_snack" to leads. high-engagement -> SE queue.
Ben (Growth): segmentation rules: visited_tutorial (nurture), registered (reminder sequence), attended (qualified), forked_repo (developer follow). UTMs: `?utm_source=accel-snack&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=dev_accel`
Priya (Content): draft social blurb: "Ship a tiny LLM feature in 30 minutes with our Developer Accelerator. 2 tutorials + live lab. RSVP." email subject: "Ship an LLM mini-feature in one short lab"
Liam (PMM): bench command draft: `./run_local_bench --model rwd-neo-small --seq 384 --batch 12 --quantize int8 --cache prefix` (we'll include exact machine spec in repo).
Sam (Design): thumbnails: square + 16:9 hero + social card. I'll push variants v1 to drive.
Ana (DevRel): owners: Priya=copy & blog, Liam=bench + reproducibility, Sam=design, Ben=distribution & routing, Ana=webinar ops & repo maintainer. all good?
All: :+1:
Priya (Content): timeline suggestion: Day0: announce + tutorial #1; Day2: tutorial #2 + RSVP push; Day4: webinar + bench post + follow-up nurture. compress if needed.
Ben (Growth): compress acceptable if bench appendix kept small. I'll set up the form and connect tracking.
Liam (PMM): hero stat candidate: "~30% lower per-token cost with int8 quant + prefix caching; p95 latency within 10%" need sign-off.
Priya (Content): will wait on hero stat for final copy.
Ana (DevRel): PR checklist: starter-repo, README quickstart, two gifs, bench logs, slides, CTA (star repo + sign up). aim to open PR by EOD.
ops-bot: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/dev-accelerator/pull/3 (initial tutorial + assets)
Sam (Design): uploaded v1 assets to drive and linked in PR.
Ben (Growth): routing detail: webhook -> passport system should include `source=accel-snack` and tag `accel_high` for attend+fork. SEops gets a Slack alert for accel_high leads.
Liam (PMM): I'll prepare two small slides "How we measured" and a reproducibility appendix with raw logs.
Priya (Content): social calendar draft ready; will schedule once hero stat confirmed.
Ana (DevRel): action items: everyone add ETA to PR and flag blockers by EOD. ops-bot please ping 24h before publish.
ops-bot: scheduled reminder: 24h before publish to channel #marketing
Ben (Growth): I'll create a dashboard tile for the funnel and set alerts for conversion dips.
Ana (DevRel): great. excited for a tight, dev-first launch that prioritizes hands-on signal and easy follow-up. :rocket:
